scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Inspect statistics and the automatic threshold separately
cases.input_contract: Return the optimized-plan size estimate for dimension as a nonnegative integer, and record the configured automatic broadcast threshold and actual dimension row count.
cases.expected: A positive finite estimate below 10485760 bytes, threshold 10485760 and actual row count 20. The estimate is not a peak-memory measurement.
cases.verification: Assert the finite estimate range and print estimate, threshold, rows andSpark version as separate fields.

cases.title: Observe the automatic plan and verify its relational output
cases.input_contract: Build an ordinary inner equality join on key, projecting fact_id, key, amount, factor. Execute logical metrics and record the physical plan chosen with the declared threshold.
cases.expected: Metrics(20000,20000,79997,839916). The observed plan identifies a join strategy and is printed with current threshold.
cases.verification: Assert all metrics and a join operator marker. Report the observed automatic strategy without treating a default as a universal guarantee.

cases.title: Disable automatic broadcasting for a fresh comparison
cases.input_contract: Set automatic broadcast threshold to-1, build a fresh ordinary join and record its plan withAQE disabled. Keep the logical result contract.
cases.expected: Same metrics as automatic. No BroadcastHashJoin in this fresh query underAQEfalse and threshold-1.
cases.verification: Assert all four metrics, the disabled setting and observed absence of BroadcastHashJoin.

cases.title: Request an eligible explicit broadcast and reconcile bags
cases.input_contract: Apply broadcast to the dimension for an inner equality join while automatic threshold remains-1. Project the same columns and compare duplicate-sensitive output with the ordinary join in both directions.
cases.expected: BroadcastHashJoin and BroadcastExchange appear. Both exceptAll differences are empty and logical metrics remain exact.
cases.verification: Assert the two operator markers, all metrics and both bag differences.

cases.title: Observe an unsupported hint without changing the business result
cases.input_contract: Request a broadcast dimension in a full outer equality join and inspect the chosen plan. Explain why this fixture still has the same output rows as the inner join.
cases.expected: No BroadcastHashJoin for this unsupported full-outer hash strategy. Metrics remain(20000,20000,79997,839916) because both key domains are fully covered.
cases.verification: Assert the observed absence of BroadcastHashJoin and exact output metrics;report a hint warning if emitted rather than hiding it.

cases.title: Gate a broadcast candidate on explicit bounded evidence
cases.input_contract: Reject streaming inputs, more than 100 rows, missing/duplicate keys, or an estimated size outside(0,1MiB]. Return the bounded dimension with a broadcast hint only after those checks.
cases.expected: The 20-row dimension passes;the same dimension with a duplicate key and a101-row candidate fail. No unbounded input is collected or materialized by the gate.
cases.verification: Assert accepted logical join metrics and explicit rejection for duplicate and row-budget cases.
